title: Implement a price-time-priority matching engine
prompt: Return a small integer-price/quantity reference limit-order book with price-time priority, cancel, and GTC/IOC/FOK. submit(id,side,price,quantity,tif) returns trades (resting_id,price,quantity) and unfilled quantity; FOK checks liquidity before mutation. IDs are never reused. O(N log N) sorting is intentional; this does not claim the Rust engine's complexity.
